name: Anyverse Dynamics
summary: Anyverse Dynamics is a Beijing company developing embodied AI and its own robot hardware. Its approach combines world models and reinforcement learning with a mobile-manipulation platform for industrial and commercial tasks. Its manufacturer materials identify K15 as a second-generation self-developed robot and describe the MWA embodied-intelligence system. The company operates under the Chinese name Wujie Dongli.
